sentences.en: Please submit a sentence to be translated into other languages.
sentences.zh: 请提交一个要翻译成其他语言的句子。

sentences.en: Edit your work better before you submit it, it's sloppy.
sentences.zh: 在提交之前最好把你的作品编辑得更仔细一些，它有点粗略。

sentences.en: From now on, I'll only submit sensible sentences to Tatoeba.
sentences.zh: 从现在起，我只会向塔拓巴提交有意义的句子。
